text:
A sealed box contains a fixed mass of gas.
Which action results in each molecule of the gas colliding with the walls of the container less
frequently and with a smaller force?
A
Decrease the temperature of the gas.
B
Decrease the volume of the container.
C
Increase the temperature of the gas.
D
Increase the volume of the container.

options.label: A
options.text: Decrease the temperature of the gas.

options.label: B
options.text: Decrease the volume of the container.

options.label: C
options.text: Increase the temperature of the gas.

options.label: D
options.text: Increase the volume of the container.
